description: A3 task 7 (F5): the circuit’s recorded round in Round 7’s dialog, read back from stored history (#730; REQ-021, C48, G13; JOURNEY-021, completion owner). check-01 proves the wiring on the real components: on /workout, CircuitBlock (src/ui/circuit-block.tsx) over the one circuit controller (src/state/circuit.ts, usePersistedCircuit) confirms Finish round N in Round 7’s LoggingOverlay titled Round N recorded, replacing Round 7’s in-memory round clock: the round time is read back from circuit.state.history, the circuit’s rest runs inside the dialog (drawn there instead of beside the card), the dialog closes itself when that rest ends (or the card’s Start round ends it), and with no rest to run (none prescribed, or the last round) the confirmation shows and the dialog then closes itself (owner decision 5, 2026-11-16); Take back this round is takeBackRound and resumes the round’s own clock; the X and Escape change nothing; focus returns to the round clock’s control however it closed; a reload comes back to the card. It runs the three circuit test files whole (the carried TASK-021 cases, AC-061/062/063 and AC-051 included). parity (TASK-AC-2FA21EDA32B4) captures /workout’s circuit round and circuit movement entry beside the accepted gallery states circuit-round and circuit-movement (gallery bec4454) at 320 and 390 with matched data, comparing every visible word and every element box; receipts in evidence/refinement/task-107/parity/, captures in the evidence store under clear-gallery-adoption-v2-20261118/task-107/captures/. Every declared case must execute and pass.
